exposure: Women without a history of prior myomectomy undergoing cesarean delivery
Women with a history of prior myomectomy undergoing cesarean delivery
outcome: Incidence of blood transfusion (intraoperative and postpartum)
cohort: 34,002 women undergoing planned cesarean delivery at term with singleton gestations
finding: Women with prior myomectomy undergoing planned cesarean delivery had a significantly higher risk of intraoperative transfusion compared to women without a history of myomectomy.
mod_finding: This study investigated maternal and neonatal outcomes after prior myomectomy in women undergoing planned cesarean delivery.
